 SALEM, Ore. (KATU) — Police in Salem are reminding drivers to slow down in the rainy weather after responding to a series of crashes on Sunnyside Road SE on Wednesday.
 The initial two-car crash happened shortly after 8 a.m. near the Kuebler Boulevard intersection. 
 Police said two more crashes happened shortly afterward as traffic started to back up in the area.
 There were no significant injuries from the collisions, Salem Police said.
 All northbound lanes of Sunnyside Road were closed, as well as two westbound lanes of Kuebler Boulevard.

 They had the collisions cleared about a half hour later.
 “Just a quick reminder with the rainy weather upon us, stopping takes longer on wet roads, so please drive with care, and do not drive distracted,” the Salem Police Department said on X.
